heading, For HR and People leaders looking to attract and retain the best talent, level 2
Reproductive health benefits, like family-forming, fertility and menopause support, have been proven to attract and retain the best talent.

In an increasingly competitive market, it's getting harder to hire and keep the best people. Get ahead of your competition by giving your people access to an employee benefit that they actually need and want.
The impact of working with Fertifa
Improve employee wellbeing and drive better health outcomes
Attract and retain the best talent, with the best benefits
Build a diverse workforce that works for all of your employees

heading, For Rewards and Benefits professionals wanting to drive organisational performance, level 2
Organisational performance is driven by inclusive benefits that work for all employees.
We provide reproductive health support for all of life's biggest challenges, and for all people. We offer a comprehensive and inclusive solution that delivers better health outcomes for employees.
The impact of working with Fertifa
Build an inclusive workplace, with inclusive benefits
heading, For Health and Wellbeing professionals looking for better health outcomes, level 2
When an individual is going through a health challenge, their productivity is impacted and their general engagement drops.
Whether it's going through an IVF cycle or struggling through menopause symptoms, it's all they're thinking about and it's trickling into every part of their day.

Providing your employees with access to a comprehensive healthcare benefit will improve their overall wellbeing and drive better health outcomes. Your people will feel supported and you will see a more engaged workforce.
The impact of working with Fertifa
Improve employee wellbeing and health outcomes

heading, For Diversity and Inclusion leaders supporting wider company goals, level 2
Your diversity and inclusion metrics matter, to future hires and to your existing employees.

Women are leaving the workforce because they don't feel supported by their employers, from common gynaecological challenges, to pregnancy and becoming a parent, to menopause. And LGBTQ+ people are leaving the workforce because they don't feel represented in their family-forming journeys.
Reproductive health benefits are crucial in increasing the number of senior women and minority groups in leadership positions. Build an organisation that does things the right way, for everyone.
The impact of working with Fertifa
Retain female employees in leadership positions
Build a diverse organisation that works for everyone
Meet your targets in a way that's not just a tick-box exercise

Read about the real impact we’ve had on employees and how we’ve supported their journeys into family forming, managed menopause symptoms and opened up important conversations around topics that are traditionally off-limit in our workplaces.
